text:
isabella: Quick report: the Next/Edge onboarding sample fails only after the adapter build when targeting ESM. Runtime: "TypeError: Class extends value undefined". Local node dev is fine.
isabella: Pushed a minimal repro and these configs into the repo.
isabella: package.json snippet:
```
{
  "name": "rw-onboard-sample",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    "import": "./dist/sdk.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/sdk.cjs"
  }
}
```
isabella: tsconfig.json snippet:
```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "declaration": true,
    "isolatedModules": true
  }
}
```
owen: Bundlers sometimes insert CJS compat wrappers or inline conditional requires; when those are rewritten for edge adapters you can end up with undefined module values which breaks class extends chains.
frank: Do we ship a runtime shim in the SDK that does `if (typeof exports === 'object') module.exports = require('./sdk.cjs')`? Those are a magnet for bundler rewrites.
isabella: yes, sample currently relies on a tiny conditional shim so we can test both require + import locally.
marie: Two issues to address: runtime interop (ESM/CJS shims) and typing ergonomics (generics defaulted to `unknown` making JS UX poor).
owen: For edge samples the simplest robust path is to publish/import ESM-only artifacts (no conditional CJS runtime glue). That avoids the shim being transformed.
frank: Agreed. Also some shims can pull polyfills that reference globals like `self` which blow up in edge runtimes. I've seen that show up as earlier "self is not defined" errors before the subclassing symptom.
marie: On typings: our SDK currently exposes `request<R>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<R>` with `R` defaulting to `any` in some places and `unknown` in others. JS users using the sample often get `unknown` back and no autocomplete.
owen: Pragmatic typing pattern: expose a JS-first overload plus the strict generic overload, e.g.
```
request(path: string, body?: any): Promise<Record<string, any>>;
request<T = unknown>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T>;
```
That gives vanilla JS consumers useful results while keeping TS strict when people opt into generics.
frank: Also provide tiny helpers in the SDK to opt-in ergonomics: `client.json<T = any>(...)` and `client.raw(...)` so sample README can show both styles.
isabella: I tried toggling `esModuleInterop` on in the sample tsconfig and it fixed the runtime in one adapter, but then several type-overload tests regressed in CI. So toggling compiler flags is noisy.
owen: Another good sample tweak: set `moduleResolution` to `node16` (not `bundler`) for sample tsconfigs that target modern bundlers. Many bundlers handle node16 exports resolution more predictably.
marie: Actionable immediate plan for the sample: 1) switch sample package.json to import-only ESM during onboarding/sample build, 2) change sample tsconfig.moduleResolution to `node16`, 3) remove CJS runtime shim from sample artifacts, 4) add `client.json` helper and a short README example showing `await client.request<{embedding:number[]}>(...)` and `await client.json('/embed', {q})` for JS.
frank: Also add a post-build unit that requires/imports the built ESM artifact and asserts `typeof ExportedClient === 'function'` and `new ExportedClient(...)` is constructible. That would've caught this earlier.
isabella: Good idea. Last ask: can we add a CI smoke job that builds the sample as ESM and runs it in a local edge dev runtime (vercel dev / deno)? If that runs on PRs it will catch these adapter-specific shims.
owen: +1. devx-bot style: lightweight workflow that runs `pnpm build` then `vercel dev --token $VERCEL_TOKEN --local-config` or `deno task start` depending on adapter. Failing that, at least run a node-based sanity test against the built ESM bundle.
marie: I'll open a small PR with the sample changes + helper APIs and include a short TS/JS snippet in the PR showing improved inference so reviewers can validate.
frank: dev-ci task please. ci-bot?
ci-bot: created issue #1588: "devex: add ESM-only sample build + edge runtime smoke test" with labels devex/ci and priority/medium. Assigned to @isabella.
isabella: Thanks, I'll land the ESM-only sample changes and the smoke CI and ping for review once green.
owen: Thanks all. Also please add a one-line changelog entry: "samples: prefer ESM-only artifacts for edge adapters; add JS-friendly typing overloads and helper APIs".
